{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = '/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv'
data = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Filter for new customers reached by paid search
filtered_data = data[
    (data['customer_segment'] == 'new') &
    (data['channel'] == 'paid_search')
]

# Calculate conversion fraction
total_new_paid_search = len(filtered_data)
converted_new_paid_search = filtered_data['converted'].sum()
conversion_fraction = converted_new_paid_search / total_new_paid_search

# Print results
print(f"Total new customers reached by paid search: {total_new_paid_search}")
print(f"Converted among them: {converted_new_paid_search}")
print(f"Conversion fraction: {conversion_fraction}")"}
